units.source_text: 此句据《后撰集》所载古歌“或喜或悲同此心，一样泪流两不分”改写，

en.t: This line is adapted from an old poem recorded in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems, which says that joy and sorrow share the same heart and that tears flow alike, impossible to distinguish.

units.source_text: 强调明石夫人所流是欢喜之泪。

en.t: It emphasizes that the tears Lady Akashi shed were tears of joy.
